items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 16 at 8:06PM EDT until October 17 at 6:00AM EDT by NWS Mount Holly NJ
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, west winds 15 to 25 kt
with gusts up to 30 kt and seas 3 to 5 ft expected. For the
Gale Warning, north winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 40 kt
and seas 5 to 8 ft expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Great Egg Inlet to Fenwick Island
DE out 20 NM.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, until 6 AM EDT Saturday.
For the Gale Warning, from 6 AM Saturday to 6 AM EDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Further extensions of the Gale Warning
will likely be needed as strong northeast winds are likely to
persist into early next week.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
